sources.note: 207 entries on main at inspection; file moved here from playwright-core/src/server. viewport = layout viewport after browser UI; screen = full screen in CSS px.
Values computed by the corpus author from the other listed sources; each derived entry states its formula in `derivation`.

logical.derivation: css_px = device_px / devicePixelRatio with DPR 1 at 100% OS scaling (Playwright Desktop Chrome uses deviceScaleFactor 1): 3440 / 1 x 1440 / 1

usable.derivation: maximised window; browser UI and OS taskbar heights are not published so the layout viewport equals the panel; measure at test time

unknowns.reason: Browser chrome and OS taskbar heights are measured, not published.
OS scaling other than 100% changes DPR; profile assumes DPR 1 and says so in the derivation.
LG lists the model as discontinued; the 3440x1440 panel class remains common.
